action.description: The action to check, as a registered permission name (e.g. "audit:read", "user:read"). An unregistered action is rejected with 400. The decision subject is the authenticated caller (JWT) — this request carries no subject.

resource.description: Optional target resource id forwarded to the PDP for ownership-scoped actions (e.g. the user id for "user:read"). Omit for coarse action checks. NOTE: omitting it is NOT "check self" — an absent resource makes the ownership condition (subject.sub == resource.id) unsatisfiable, so owner-scoped actions evaluate as if querying an unknown resource.
